scope: Sandcrab phase 0: signed supervisor frames against the protocol fixture versus HTTP/1.1 over a Unix socket to a minimal Rust server; Python client for both; container limited to 2 CPUs.
limitations: Developer machine under WSL2 (Docker Desktop), not the production host; compare scenarios with each other, not with production latency.
The fixture serves RENEW without sandbox work; the HTTP server parses the same JSON and checks a token instead of a signature.
The signed-frame upload figure is a lower bound: 800 times the control-request median, without base64 or 64 KiB payloads.
